verses.text: "I have told you all this so that you will not give up your faith.
They will throw you out of the synagogues. In fact, a time is coming when anyone who kills you will think they are serving God.
They will do these things because they have not known the Father or me.
I have told you this so that when the time comes, you will remember that I warned you. I did not tell you this at the beginning, because I was with you.
But now I am going to the one who sent me. Yet none of you asks me, 'Where are you going?'
Instead, your hearts are full of sadness because I have told you these things.
But I am telling you the truth: it is better for you that I go away. If I do not go away, the Helper will not come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.
When he comes, he will show the people of the world how wrong they are about sin, about what is right, and about judgement.
About sin, because people do not believe in me.
About what is right, because I am going to the Father, where you cannot see me any more.
And about judgement, because the ruler of this world has already been judged.
I still have many things to tell you, but they would be too much for you to bear right now.
But when the Spirit of truth comes, he will guide you into all the truth. He will not speak on his own. He will speak only what he hears, and he will tell you what is still going to happen.
He will bring glory to me, because he will take what is mine and make it known to you.
Everything that belongs to the Father is mine. That is why I said the Spirit will take what is mine and make it known to you.
In a little while you will not see me any more. Then after a little while you will see me again, because I am going to the Father."

Some of his followers said to one another, "What does he mean by saying, 'In a little while you will not see me, and then after a little while you will see me'? And what does he mean by 'because I am going to the Father'?"
They kept asking, "What does he mean by 'a little while'? We do not understand what he is talking about."

Jesus saw that they wanted to ask him about this. So he said to them, "Are you asking one another what I meant when I said, 'In a little while you will not see me, and then after a little while you will see me'?
I tell you for certain, you will cry and mourn while the world celebrates. You will be sad, but your sadness will turn into joy.
A woman giving birth to a baby has pain, because her time has come. But when her baby is born, she forgets the pain because she is so happy that a child has been born into the world.
It is the same with you. Now you are sad, but I will see you again. Then your hearts will be full of joy, and no one will take that joy away from you.
On that day you will not need to ask me anything. I tell you for certain, my Father will give you whatever you ask him for in my name.
Until now you have not asked for anything in my name. Ask, and you will receive, so that your joy will be complete.
I have been speaking to you in picture language. But a time is coming when I will no longer speak like this. I will tell you plainly about my Father.
On that day you will ask in my name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father for you,
because the Father himself loves you. He loves you because you have loved me and have believed that I came from God.
I came from the Father and entered the world. Now I am leaving the world and going back to the Father."
Then his followers said, "Now you are speaking plainly and not using picture language.
Now we can see that you know everything, and you do not even need anyone to ask you questions. This makes us believe that you came from God."
Jesus answered, "So now you believe?

But a time is coming, and in fact it has already come, when you will be scattered. Each of you will go to your own home, and you will leave me all alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.
I have told you these things so that in me you may have peace. In this world you will face hardship. But be encouraged! I have overcome the world."
